question.text: In a metre bridge experiment the balance point is obtained if the gaps are closed by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>. A shunt of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> is added to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> resistor to shift the balancing point by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>22</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi></math> is ______.

solution.text:
Case 1: No shunt is added

The initial balancing length l of the bridge is,

23=l100-l

⇒200-2l=3l⇒l=40 cm

Case 2: When shunt is added

The new balancing length is, l1=22.5+40=62.5 cm

So, 62.537.5=23X3+X

⇒X=2.
